name: smwmusic-kirubiru-slash-the-building-act
title: Kirubiru: Slash the Building? - Act 2 Theme
description:
A piano-only song from the doujin game Kirubiru. Could fit boss battle or castle/final levels.

This port uses the optimized SMW sample set, because the piano samples take up a lot of ARAM. As an alternative, you can use the default SMW samples (but with Thunder SFX and @7 disabled) by following instruction:
- Go look for a line "#define DisableSFX 0" and change the value to "1".
- Open and copy the contents inside "Kirubiru_Act_2_sample_group.txt", and add them into "Addmusic_sample_groups.txt" in your AddmusicK folder.
